headline: Committee will review classroom technology use, including the Chromebook+ rollout and a Grading & Schedule Task Force update.
summary: The Curriculum and Student Success Committee will discuss the district's vision for classroom technology, current uses of technology for instruction, and an update on the Chromebook+ rollout. The committee will also hear an update from the Grading & Schedule Task Force.
